nodes.label: ADR 0163: One computer never clashes with itself
nodes.rationale: Sync design decision: a computer's own GLUE Home and browser tab never clash with each other; clashes show in the tab's box when GLUE Home is running; a tab sends only what it changed

nodes.label: A computer never clashes with itself
nodes.rationale: Place names this computer's devices (own: GLUE Home and browser sign-in); changes from them merge without clash; clashes recorded from one are dropped on read, gone on save

nodes.label: GLUE Home shows clashes in the tab
nodes.rationale: Engine answers clashes for the open collection and resolve (one answered: value into file, clash forgotten, file read again and in feed)

nodes.label: Tab sends only what it changed
nodes.rationale: Tab sends song with record it had (was field); engine applies only fields changed from it over its own (changed_over); prevents races between cover/analysis reads and saves

nodes.label: ADR 0163: One computer never clashes with itself; GLUE Home shows its clashes; a tab sends only what it changed
nodes.rationale: Context: before ADR 0162 both page and GLUE Home wrote same songs; resulted in 61 unresolvable clashes. Decision: computer never clashes with itself; with GLUE Home running, tab shows clashes; tab sends only changed fields. Consequences: clashes now solvable, edits survive races.
